title: CALM: Conflict-Aware Lifecycle Memory Governance for Long-Horizon Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.38573v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A memory can be outdated for present-day reasoning yet indispensable for reconstructing the past. Relevance-based retrieval overlooks this tension: semantic relevance, evidence-grounded validity, and query-specific eligibility are distinct. We propose CALM, a conflict-aware lifecycle memory governance framework that decouples persistent memory preservation from query-time admission. CALM converts heterogeneous records into evidence-grounded memory cells, updates validity and lifecycle states using support, conflict, and dependency signals, and admits query-appropriate evidence through training-free or learned gating informed by temporal applicability. Across LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with Qwen and GPT backbones, CALM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the best overall accuracy. translated_title: CALM：面向长程语言代理的冲突感知生命周期记忆治理框架
translated_abstract: 一条记忆对于当下的推理可能已经过时，但对于重构过去却不可或缺。基于相关性的检索忽视了这种张力：语义相关性、基于证据的有效性以及针对特定查询的适用性是三个不同的概念。我们提出了CALM，一个冲突感知的生命周期记忆治理框架，它将持久记忆的保存与查询时的准入进行了解耦。CALM将异构记录转换为基于证据的记忆单元，利用支持、冲突和依赖信号来更新有效性和生命周期状态，并通过基于时间适用性的免训练或学习式门控机制来准入符合查询需求的证据。在LongMemEval-S和LoCoMo数据集上，使用Qwen和GPT骨干模型，CALM超越了最先进的基线方法，取得了最佳的整体准确率。与简单的过滤和重排序相比，基于查询条件的准入进一步提升了证据选择的效果。冲突阻断和鲁棒性分析……
tldr: 提出冲突感知的生命周期记忆治理框架CALM，通过将持久记忆保存与查询时准入解耦，利用支持、冲突和依赖信号更新记忆有效性与生命周期状态，并借助时间感知的门控机制准入查询适用的证据，在长程语言代理记忆基准上取得最佳整体准确率。
en_tdlr: CALM is a conflict-aware lifecycle memory governance framework that decouples persistent memory preservation from query-time admission, converting heterogeneous records into evidence-grounded memory cells and admitting query-appropriate evidence through temporal-aware training-free or learned gating, achieving the best overall accuracy on long-horizon language agent benchmarks.
